newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran says dam pact signing in October.
newsitem.headline: Ekran says dam pact signing in October.

text.p: A 13.6 billion ringgit contract between Malaysian timber and construction firm Ekran Bhd and a consortium led by ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG to build the Bakun hydroelectric dam will be signed sometime this month, Ekran said.
Ekran did not give further details in a statement issued to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange accompanying its annual results for the year ended June 30.

The signing ceremony was supposed to be held on Monday but was abruptly postponed without explanation on Friday -- the second time the ceremony has been delayed -- leading to stock market speculation that Ekran executive chairman Ting Pek Khiing was in ill-health.
Officials at Singapore's Mount Elizabeth Hospital said on Monday Ting was a patient there for nine days but was discharged on September 28.
Minister of Energy, Post and Telecommunications, Leo Moggie, told reporters on Monday the delay was because parties to the contract were still haggling over the fine print.

"I believe the legal people and the contractors want to finalise the wordings of the agreement, and I understand they have rescheduled another meeting this afternoon (Monday), and, therefore, they have to postpone the signing ceremony," he said.
Officials at Ekran have been unavailable for comment on the postponements.

The agreement was to be signed between the dam's operating company Bakun Hydroelectric Corporation (BHC) and the ABB consortium whose other major partner is Brazil's Companhia Brasileria Projectos e Obras (CBPO).

The consortium was awarded the contract in June to design and build the dam, located in the remote interior of Malaysia's Borneo state of Sarawak. Work on the 2,400 MW dam was scheduled to begin in January and completed by 2002.

The BHC groups Ekran, the Sarawak State Government, the Sarawak Electricity Supply Corporation, the national electricity company Tenaga Nasional Bhd, the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) and Malaysia Mining Corporation.
